description.de: Führt Flutter analyze und Tests aus — blockiert Release bei Test-Fehlern
description.en: Runs Flutter analyze and tests — blocks release on test failures

config.label: Flutter App analysieren und testen
config.command:
set -uo pipefail
command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'flutter not found in PATH'; echo 'gate_status: RED'; echo 'gate_category: app-build'; echo 'gate_description: Flutter CLI fehlt — Build kann nicht ausgeführt werden'; exit 1; }
cd '{{ project_path }}' || { echo 'project_path not accessible: {{ project_path }}'; echo 'gate_status: RED'; echo 'gate_category: app-build'; exit 1; }

echo '=== Flutter Analyze ==='
flutter analyze --no-pub 2>&1
ANALYZE_EXIT=$?

echo ''
echo '=== Flutter Test ==='
flutter test 2>&1
TEST_EXIT=$?

echo ''
echo '--- Build Gate Summary ---'
echo "Analyze exit code: $ANALYZE_EXIT"
echo "Test exit code: $TEST_EXIT"

if [ $TEST_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "gate_status: RED"
  echo "gate_category: app-build"
  echo "gate_description: Flutter-Tests fehlgeschlagen — Release blockiert"
  exit 1
elif [ $ANALYZE_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "gate_status: YELLOW"
  echo "gate_category: app-build"
  echo "gate_description: Flutter analyze hat Warnungen — Tests bestanden"
else
  echo "gate_status: GREEN"
  echo "gate_category: app-build"
  echo "gate_description: App-Tests bestanden, keine Analyze-Fehler"
fi
